title: Validate live analytics using the explicit anonymous report schema

request.text: Ok, make it as complete as you can and then leave a message for me that says what I need to do when you're done.
request.source: Bounded addition to release-service-verification-corrections: source review found the old live validator rejects the approved word_length dimension via /word/. Preserve privacy rejection by allowing only the reviewed complete row-key set, with deterministic positive and negative tests. No credential authorization is implied by this test-source change.

requirements.text: Live analytics verification accepts exactly the approved row dimensions including word_length, rejects every unknown/identity key before claiming the response valid, and retains authenticated status/cache checks. Deterministic regressions exercise the actual helper used by the live probe, including empty rows, malformed row containers and arbitrary injected keys.

r01.summary: Both deterministic regressions failed with the previous forbidden-word heuristic. The actual live helper now accepts the reviewed aggregate keys including word_length and rejects arbitrary unknown keys and malformed containers; live authorization/status/cache checks remain intact.

areas.request_match: Removes a proven false rejection and strengthens the live release check without weakening privacy or replacing current Production evidence.
areas.behavior: Reviewed query dimensions are enumerated explicitly; each observed row must be an object and every key must belong to the allowlist. Empty reports remain valid.
areas.failure_recovery: Unexpected identity, content and arbitrary new keys fail closed. Malformed row containers fail before an endpoint can be declared verified. Production HTTP/status/cache assertions remain unchanged.
areas.blast_radius: Changes only the test helper and deterministic regressions; no website runtime, database or app behavior changes.
areas.test_depth: Two failing-before regressions exercise every approved key, ten forbidden/unknown examples and seven malformed shapes through the exact helper used by the live probe. Full website source suite is also recorded.
areas.remaining_risks: Protected Production checks still require the pending explicit credential approval. Source tests are not delivery observations, and Apple/native release checks remain independent.
